tickets.title: fork: sidebar.set_hud projection, request crown, +N prj and the minimal rail's HUD marks
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud (dispatch with cwd there; land via its own land block). D-2026-11-27-05, design `~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/README.md`, frames C1/C3/C5 in `~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/tui/preview.mjs`. Add one bounded API `sidebar.set_hud` (generation-tagged JSON, bounded size, leased like `pane.strip.set` so an expired lease shows `·` stale instead of frozen marks; documented in HUD-FORK.md) carrying: owner requests (count, first request's project, age, sentence), launcher counts, extra project count, and per-run graph data keyed by `hud_group`/`hud_subgroup` (consumed by unified-left/03, only stored here). Draw from it: the crown above `spaces` when requests exist (0 rows when calm: `?N project · waits age` + the sentence), the launcher row `◆ Home Proj Exec·N Ctrl` (click sends `sidebar.hud_activate {gen, target}` as an event HUD subscribes to), `+N prj` in the spaces header (activates Home). In the existing 4-column folded sidebar: `?N` as the top row when requests exist, and folded groups show their strongest state shape before the count (`▸×2`). Every existing sidebar function stays unchanged.

tickets.title: HUD publishes the sidebar projection on change and opens pages from sidebar clicks
tickets.live_try: Main: with the fork from unified-left/01 installed, file and resolve a synthetic owner request and watch the crown; click each launcher item.
tickets.what: MyHUD side of unified-left/01. D-2026-11-27-05, design `docs/design/unified-left/README.md`. The running panel (or hud-watch when no panel runs) builds the projection from the same facts Home uses (owner requests with Home's order and rule, active-today projects, runs and their steps with state, role glyph and live pane id) and sends `sidebar.set_hud` only when it changes. Event-driven: watch jobs-revision.json, flows/, unattended records and every registered project's `.hud/` and STATE.md (STATE.md edits do not bump jobs-revision.json); no timer. Renew the lease while alive. Handle `sidebar.hud_activate`: open the named page (Home, Project, Execution, Control; Execution at a run/step when the target names one) in today's panel.

acceptance.text: Unit tests: projection built from fixture state matches Home's requests and runs; unchanged state sends nothing
Test: editing a fixture STATE.md waiting item updates the projection without a timer
Test: hud_activate targets open the matching page and step
Live try by main on the installed fork: an owner request appears in the crown within a second and clears when resolved

tickets.title: fork: running workflows as miniature graphs in the agents tree and the 13-column rail
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud. D-2026-11-27-05, frames C1 and C3 in `~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/tui/preview.mjs`. In the expanded agents section, a `hud_subgroup` that has run data in the projection renders as `run <name>  age` followed by its miniature graph (parallel steps fanned with box rules, then review/accept), `▾/▸` folding it; state shape glued before the role glyph. A step with a live pane is a hit that focuses it (peeks a hidden tab); any other step emits `sidebar.hud_activate` for Execution at that step. Add a per-client preference command so HUD Settings can set the folded form (persisted like the other per-client preferences).

tickets.title: fork: the dock as a center ◆ HUD tab, hidden on navigation, pinnable at wide widths; narrow header summary
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud. D-2026-11-27-05, frames C2 and C4. A new dock placement `center`: the dock terminal fills the pane surface as a peeked tab labelled `[◆ HUD · <page>]` (page name from a HUD-settable label), using the hidden-tab peek semantics; focusing any workspace, tab or agent hides it again (the terminal keeps running); focus, copy mode and zoom work as for the docked forms. At pane-surface widths of at least 112 columns a pin key (`P`, or a `dock.pin` command) shows it as a push split beside the panes instead. Narrow terminals (mobile threshold): header row 2 shows state counts, `?N` and one-line run strips from the projection; the center tab fills the width. Edge placements (left/right/bottom, push/overlay) stay unchanged as settings.

tickets.title: fork: the sidebar matches frames C1/C3/C5 cell for cell (golden tests); run members are not listed twice
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud. Owner live view 2026-11-27 after 01/03/05 installed: (1) every running worker appears twice, once as a flat agent row (`● MyHUD · imp 04: …`) and again as a step under `run unified-left`; (2) flat worker rows show a yellow `●` instead of the state shape glued to the role glyph (`◐⚒`); (3) a run renders as a vertical list of steps with full titles instead of the miniature graph. Reference: frames C1 (expanded), C3 (13-column rail) and C5 (4-column minimal) in ~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/tui/preview.mjs; design ~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/README.md. Required: an agent whose pane is a step of a projected run is shown only inside that run (no flat row); every other worker row shows state shape + role glyph from `hud_icon` (never the bare status dot); a run renders as the frame shows: `run <name>  age` header, parallel steps fanned on one row between box rules (`╭────┬────╮` / `✓01  ×02⚒ ?03⚒` / `├╌╌╌╌┴╌╌╌╌╯`), sequential tail on one row (`○ review ╌ ○ accept`), step labels short (the projection's short label), role glyph after the step number (`×02⚒`), and a single-step run as one row (`◐◈ run audit  12m`). Add golden tests: feed the projection and snapshot that correspond to C1, C3 and C5 and assert the sidebar column matches the frame text cell for cell. Where a frame and the current projection schema disagree, change the renderer to match the frame and name any projection field you need in the report (HUD side is unified-left/08).

tickets.title: Projection: only ticket runs and workflows, one group per project, neutral role glyphs, one age format
tickets.what: Main's live capture 2026-11-27 (after 08): the sidebar projection also publishes land flows as runs (`run One reader…` with steps lease/pick/gate/merge), which the frames never show; and it mixes age formats (`40分` next to English). In src/collectors/sidebar-projection.ts: publish only ticket-queue runs and composed workflows (no land, gate or merge flows; a land in progress shows as its ticket step's state); group every run under its tracker project (`hud_group` = the project that owns the ticket, also for cross-repo tickets whose worker runs in another repo, so the fork can match the worker); set `hud_group`/`hud_subgroup` pane tokens for every worker the same way (src/runtime/pane-group.ts, direct-exec.ts) so workers of a cross-repo ticket group with their run; give every role a glyph, with a neutral fallback for roles without one (frontier-imp, prototyper, innovator, general); ages in one compact format matching the frames (`47m`, `12m`, `3h`), independent of panel language. Golden test: a fixture with one ticket queue, one land flow and one cross-repo ticket yields exactly the C1 run shape.

Test: a cross-repo ticket's run and its worker pane tokens share hud_group = tracker project
Test: unknown roles get the neutral glyph
Test: ages render as 47m/12m/3h in zh and en
Golden test against frame C1's run

comments.author: main
comments.text: Role glyph rule (main, agreed with 07): derive from the role's instructions: implementer-instruction roles (imp, frontier-imp, prototyper, general borrowing imp) `⚒`, oracle-instruction roles (oracle, innovator) `◈`, reviewer `⚖`; a HUD worker whose role still has no glyph gets `▫` (never `◇`, which is Execution's review mark). Step labels follow the frames exactly: ticket numbers glued to the shape (`✓01`), word labels spaced as drawn.
